Apple - Pear Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




2 cups Bisquick
1/2 cup milk

Preparation

1 Stir together with fork and make into a ball, knead 5 times. 2 Roll out to 15"x9". Spread with butter then sprinkle with brown sugar, 1 grated apple and 2 pears. Over this sprinkle with white sugar and cinnamon. 3 Roll up tight and slice, put into greased cupcake pans.
